title: spawn_node position parse narrows i64 to i32 without a range check — out-of-range coords silently wrap
detail: parse_int returns i64; i32(x) narrows silently — verified: "3000000000" parses ok then wraps to -1294967296; negative coords also accepted. The fail-loud guard fires only for non-numeric input; the new verb has no i32 range guard.
recommended_fix: Range-check before narrowing: reject coordinates outside i32 (or world) bounds with the same fail-loud 'bad spawn_node position' error used for non-numeric input.

title: fixture off + spawn referencing node ids outside the spawn_node set: packets silently culled, demo still passes
detail: With fixture off, spawns referencing ids outside the spawn_node set are never validated: the packet spawns at a missing node, finds no route, and is silently culled — the demo still PASSes. Missing-id draws fail loud via replay_error; the spawn path stays silent.
recommended_fix: Validate spawn src/dst against live node ids at lower_spawns, fail loud like lower_nodes' unknown-type error, or latch an error when a packet is culled at a missing node.

title: parse_demo error returns discard the partially-built Demo — cloned Node_Spawn type_names and dynamic arrays leak
detail: Every parse_demo error return ('return {}, ...') discards the partially-built Demo: already-cloned Node_Spawn type_names (default allocator) plus the dynamic arrays leak. run_demo and load_demo_replay both return on perr without cleanup. CLI-bounded, one-shot leak.
recommended_fix: On parse error, free the partial demo (delete cloned type_names and dynamic arrays) before returning, in parse_demo itself or via a caller cleanup path.
